aiDisclosure: Code, writing and original model geometry were substantially created with AI assistance. Human graphical playtesting remains pending.

packs.name: Signalkeepers
packs.tagline: Bring a forgotten town back on the air.
packs.description: A cooperative three-relay expedition with a battery-powered scanner, rising interference, temporary echo enemies, a tree winch and two endings.
packs.testStatus: Historical 33-check server report included; graphical playtest pending.
packs.conflicts: One shared expedition per world. Overworld only. Full modpack compatibility untested.

packs.name: Field Instruments
packs.tagline: Tools that look like they belong in the field.
packs.description: Three original 3D item models for the Signalkeepers scanner, canopy winch and relic, using references to vanilla textures. No texture images are redistributed.
packs.testStatus: JSON and model references checked; in-game visual review pending.
packs.conflicts: Overrides carrot-on-a-stick, warped-fungus-on-a-stick and amethyst-shard item model definitions.

packs.name: Trail Ledger
packs.tagline: Let the world fill the pages.
packs.description: A seven-biome field journal using vanilla advancements. Discover forests, deserts, jungles, snowy plains, swamps, badlands and mushroom fields; complete the journal for a named compass.
packs.entrypoint: Open Advancements → Trail Ledger, then explore.
packs.testStatus: Validated on the official Java 1.21.1 server with two protocol clients; see the 26-check collection report. Human graphical playtest pending.
packs.conflicts: Vanilla biome IDs only. Rewards are once per player unless an operator resets advancements.

packs.name: Hearthside
packs.tagline: A little warmth goes a long way.
packs.description: Opt into campfire rest. Crouch directly above a lit ordinary or soul campfire while well fed for ten seconds to receive a brief regeneration effect. Move away or stand to reset the timer.
packs.testStatus: Validated on the official Java 1.21.1 server with two protocol clients; see the 26-check collection report. Human graphical playtest pending.
packs.conflicts: Does not prevent campfire damage; cover the campfire with a hay bale or other safe arrangement and test your rest spot. Scans one and two blocks below you.

packs.name: Fieldcraft
packs.description: A compact survival recipe collection: unpack wool to string, turn rotten flesh into leather by slow cooking, recover flint from gravel, and craft leads, name tags and saddles using readable recipes.
packs.entrypoint: Recipes unlock on joining; open the recipe book.
packs.testStatus: Validated on the official Java 1.21.1 server with two protocol clients; see the 26-check collection report. Human graphical playtest pending.
packs.conflicts: Changes survival balance. Uses namespaced recipes; other packs may supply competing ingredients.
